actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks. Alternatively, it uses its Steel Shot twice.

actions.desc: The golem's body explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of the golem must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone. The golem immediately scatters.

traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Immutable Form

traits.name: Magic Weapons

traits.desc: If the golem is scattered and has at least 1 hit point, it can reform as a bonus action in any space containing at least one of its caltrops without provoking an opportunity attack. If it reforms within 5 feet of a prone creature, it can make one slam attack against that creature as part of this bonus action.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Реформ». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Reform

traits.desc: As a bonus action, the bearing golem can disperse, scattering its caltrops in a 15-foot cube, centered on the space it previously occupied. A creature moving through a space containing any of the golem’s caltrops must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage. Taking this damage reduces the creature's walking speed by 10 feet until the creature regains at least 1 hit point. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save. While scattered, the bearing golem can’t attack or move, except to reform, and it can’t be targeted by attacks or spells. It can still take damage from spells that deal damage in an area.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Скаттер». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).

ru.description:
Рассеяние металлических колючек сгущается в постоянно сдвигающуюся гуманоидную форму.

Составленный из тысяч колючек, голем из колючек может принимать почти любую форму, которую он выберет, хотя он всегда остаётся скоплением металлических колючек.
ru.name: Голем из колючек
